newsitem.title: USA: Bausch partner files for new allergy drug.
newsitem.headline: Bausch partner files for new allergy drug.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb Inc said Monday today that a new drug application for an ophthalmic anti-allergy drug has been submitted to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The application was submitted by Pharmos Corp which has given Bausch & Lomb the right to manufacture and market the product in the U.S. and selected international markets.
The application is the second to be filed in a line of three ophthalmic drugs containing loteprednol etabonate, a site-specific steroid.
The loteprednol-based product has been evaluated in Phase III clinical trials for its efficacy in seasonal allergic conjunctivitis, a common eye allergy.
